findings.description: The matcher switched from re.match (prefix match) to fullmatch, so a pattern now only matches if it spans the entire exception string.
findings.rationale: Trigger: retry_if_exception_message(match="connection") with an exception whose str is "connection refused". Before, self.match.match returned a match and the exception was retried. Now fullmatch returns None, so the retry is silently skipped. The diff only touches None-vs-truthiness checks, so this unrelated semantic change is unintended and breaks existing callers that rely on prefix matching.
